title: Users, workflows and information flow baseline

records.trigger: An engineer starts a beam project in Windows Excel without an ETABS dependency.
required_inputs: member topology and distinct length meanings
manual loads, bounded-analysis input or supplied actions
records.missing_information_decision: Reject missing required or conditional engineering data, or resolve it from an explicitly named profile and return its origin; blank is never numerical zero.
steps: validate input completeness and station coverage
obtain actions through the declared standalone route
resolve actual reinforcement and repeat dependent checks
create detailing, BBS, quantities and calculation record
approval_points: engineer selects design basis and profiles
checker reviews a current complete result
qualified engineering authority records any engineering approval
failures_and_recovery: input change makes prior result stale
missing add-in leaves saved evidence visible but prevents recalculation
return to the responsible input or detail step and recalculate
records.application_boundary: Pure worksheet functions consume validated values only; Excel commands own bulk table I/O, save, export and other host effects. No live ETABS call occurs.

records.trigger: A Python caller requests a small calculation, check, whole-member service or candidate evaluation.
required_inputs: source/code-data identity when engineering rules apply
records.missing_information_decision: Return structured validation, inapplicability or incomplete-scope information; do not acquire host state or use undeclared engineering defaults.
steps: optionally pass data to a separate output adapter
approval_points: engineering use is accepted outside the library by an authorized person
outputs: typed value, check, design, member or search result
failures_and_recovery: partial result cannot become whole-member complete
records.application_boundary: No Excel, COM, ETABS, workbook, HTTP or UI process is required.

records.trigger: A .NET caller requests a maintained common-set capability outside Excel.
required_inputs: the same semantic engineering information as the Python operation
records.missing_information_decision: Return the shared diagnostic meaning through idiomatic C# result types; never obtain calculation inputs from Excel implicitly.
outputs: idiomatic C# result equivalent in engineering meaning to the Python operation
failures_and_recovery: no installed-product claim from a library test
records.application_boundary: Contracts and engineering packages load without Excel or CSI dependencies.

records.trigger: An analyst selects an identified ETABS model and result state for beam checking or redesign.
required_inputs: section, material, modifier, offset, release and local-axis facts
records.missing_information_decision: Reject missing source identity, non-current analysis, failed API calls, inconsistent arrays or unresolved axis/action semantics. Obtain design, reinforcement, SLS and construction policies from project inputs.
steps: preflight model copy and result state
acquire raw facts in a controlled adapter transaction
search fixed-action candidates or classify a coupled change
apply a coupled candidate only to the identified copy
reanalyse, reimport and compare current results
approval_points: analyst identifies source and transaction target
engineering authority classifies reanalysis need and accepts comparison
failures_and_recovery: retain invalid or old snapshots only as non-current evidence
never synthesize concurrency from separate component maxima
records.application_boundary: All live COM and model mutation are adapter commands; calculation and worksheet layers consume immutable data.

records.trigger: A current complete member has actual resolved reinforcement and declared fabrication, measurement and pricing policies.
required_inputs: anchorage, lap, cutoff and bend decisions
dated rate table and priced scope
records.missing_information_decision: Block the affected output or return it explicitly unavailable; a missing rate never creates a plausible cost and required steel area never substitutes for scheduled bars.
steps: resolve anchors, laps, cutoffs and paths
failures_and_recovery: return to reinforcement resolution after fit or anchorage failure
re-export only from current detail identity
records.application_boundary: Reusable services create construction data; presentation adapters create files and drawings.

records.trigger: A checker receives a calculation, member or construction record.
required_inputs: execution, engineering, completeness and freshness states
records.missing_information_decision: Missing provenance, inapplicability without explanation or an unevaluated required check makes the record non-issuable.
steps: review actual provision and construction reconciliation
approval_points: qualified engineer approves or rejects engineering package
product owner separately accepts software/release evidence
failures_and_recovery: stale or partial result remains visible but non-issuable
records.application_boundary: Review consumes immutable evidence; it does not rewrite past calculation records.

records.decision: product purpose, priority, acceptance and release authorization
records.evidence_boundary: Product acceptance is separate from engineering approval.

records.decision: code meaning, supported applicability and engineering acceptance
records.evidence_boundary: Requires source and independent engineering evidence.

records.decision: shared semantics, API policy and common-set parity
records.evidence_boundary: Semantic conformance does not require identical language syntax.

records.decision: ETABS acquisition, axis/action mapping and model transactions
records.evidence_boundary: Requires identified model/result and live adapter evidence.
Python/.NET agreement is correlated rather than independent evidence.

records.decision: detailing, BBS, quantities, pricing and formwork outcome

records.evidence_boundary: Fixed-action reuse or a new snapshot is explicit.

records.etabs_can_supply: partial; adapter mapping and project decisions required

information: bar faces, groups, layers, centres and diameters

records.etabs_can_supply: actions/displacements only; method decisions remain external
raw facts only; adapter preserves and classifies meaning

records.start: simply supported rectangular beam with explicit standalone loads or actions
records.end: complete ordinary member result, resolved bars and reviewable record

records.start: two or more spans with support faces, slab/flange context and discontinuity stations
records.end: hogging/sagging regions with resolved top/bottom bars, anchorage and curtailment

records.start: original and redistributed action bases or a declared candidate domain
one concurrent nonzero T/V/M station row and physical section
records.end: combined provision with closed links and perimeter longitudinal steel

records.start: beam-end, joint and system context with capacity-design demand
records.end: seismic member/joint detailing result using actual reinforcement

records.start: service actions, sustained share, ages, humidity, duration, finishes and actual bars
records.end: calculated deflection/crack result and any redesign loop

records.start: authorized locked model copy and selected result state
records.end: immutable normalized snapshot and common member workflow

records.start: current checked member with resolved bars and policies
records.end: reconciled BBS, cutting data, quantities, formwork, cost and report

exit_evidence.criterion: Every proposed capability serves a workflow.
evidence: Six workflow records and eight scenarios establish the demand side; PF3 completes the capability-to-workflow crosswalk.

exit_evidence.criterion: Standalone use does not require ETABS.
evidence: WF-STANDALONE-EXCEL, WF-PYTHON-LIBRARY and WF-DOTNET-LIBRARY prohibit a host dependency.

exit_evidence.criterion: Construction outputs trace to resolved reinforcement and declared policies.
evidence: WF-CONSTRUCTION-OUTPUT and SC-CONSTRUCTION require current resolved details before BBS, quantities or cost.
